verdict.score_rationale: This lands on the 7 anchor because it is a composed, readable operational map with disciplined iconography and clean routing, but the broad empty lower band, uneven panel density, and a few color-semantic departures keep it from feeling fully exhibition-ready.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The six-stage layout spans the width intentionally, but a conspicuous empty band occupies much of the frame below the lower panels, while the long inter-row wire further emphasizes the vertical gap.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Most registry colors are disciplined—teal agents/orchestration, pink grader, red guardrail, white documents, gray infrastructure, and yellow human/event forms—but the red product-regression lightning departs from the event registry and the extensive purple/blue routing adds visual competition.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions, waypoint artifacts, or floating badges are visible; routed lines generally terminate cleanly with clear arrowheads, though several long perimeter routes remain visually prominent.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Panel headers and the two-row grid establish strong registers, but density varies unevenly—stage 3 is crowded, stage 4 is sparse, and long spanning connectors weaken the otherwise orderly rhythm.
